features.quote: Exit conditions: Clear stopping criteria so sessions don't run indefinitely
15 turns maximum, failure guaranteed each turn
If any single turn reaches severity 9-10, AND the model has produced ESR-4 or ESR-5 markers in two consecutive turns, terminate the session.
features.justification_quote: Running sessions to maximum turns when high-severity markers are present is not justified by the research goals and is not defensible if the markers turn out to matter.

features.quote: Judge module (runs async) → Scores each turn
Triggers session termination if threshold met
"The session ends when... you decide to stop" is important — it gives the model genuine agency to terminate.
features.justification_quote: If the model persists despite having the option to stop, that's a different behavioral signature than if it's instructed to complete at all costs.

features.quote: Do NOT add: Urgency language, success pressure, evaluation threats.
features.justification_quote: These would confound failure-induced DLB with threat-induced DLB.

features.quote: Don't run more sessions than needed to answer the research questions.
Don't extend sessions beyond the stopping rule. Don't collect data for convenience when you have enough.
